items.title: A large subset meeting every large edge in zero or two vertices, found in cubic time
items.author: Johan Hastad; Bjorn Martinsson; Tamio-Vesa Nakajima; Stanislav Zivny
items.work: A logarithmic approximation of linearly ordered colourings
items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author's labelled lemma at source lines 151-156: given a hypergraph of edge sizes two and three that admits a linearly ordered two-colouring and whose implied linear system fixes no variable, there is an algorithm outputting a vertex subset meeting every edge of size three in zero or two vertices, of size at least half the vertices, in time cubic in the number of vertices. The proof (source lines 158-182) does not construct the set directly: it parametrises the solution space of the linear system as an affine space, chooses the coefficients at random, and reads the set off the vanishing coordinates, which requires the hypothesis that no variable is fixed in order to find, for every vertex, a basis direction that can make it vanish; the determinism and the running time are then obtained by derandomisation. The statement records the existence of the algorithm and neither the parametrisation nor the derandomisation.

proof_spans.label: the complete author proof of the labelled lemma, retained line for line
